# B.L.A.S.T. OCR Engine

> B.L.A.S.T. OCR is a self-hosted, offline OCR and document intelligence engine with ONNX Runtime multi-provider acceleration (CUDA, DirectML, CPU), a bounded streaming memory architecture, table structure extraction, mathematical formula parsing, selectable dual-layer sandwich PDFs, and native AI Agent (MCP, LangChain, LlamaIndex) integrations.

B.L.A.S.T.'s default RapidOCR (ONNX) engine cuts mean CER by 18% and average CPU per-page latency by 7.7x versus the project's previous EasyOCR baseline, measured on a 14-page gold corpus (see ADR 0005). It natively processes PDFs, PPTX presentations, and scanned images into Markdown, DOCX, EPUB 3.0, dual-layer searchable PDF, and structured JSON.

## Key Features & Verified Benchmarks
- RapidOCR (ONNX Runtime, CUDA/DirectML/CPU providers): 0.1916 mean CER, 0.4739 mean WER, 0.9758 reading-order tau on the 14-page gold corpus — 7.7x lower CPU latency than the prior EasyOCR default (`eval/results/rapidocr_candidate.json`, ADR 0005).
- Table structure extraction to GitHub Flavored Markdown and HTML, scored with a built-in TEDS evaluator (`eval/teds_evaluator.py`); no end-to-end TEDS corpus score is recorded yet.
- LaTeX formula detection converting inline and display math to KaTeX.
- Bounded memory sliding-window streaming: 0.0002 MB/page growth slope on a 1,000-page stress test (`eval/results/stress_report.json`).
- Selectable dual-layer sandwich PDF generation with exact coordinate alignment.
- Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- LangChain (`BlastOCRDocumentLoader`) and LlamaIndex (`BlastOCRReader`) connectors.
- 100% private and offline execution with zero external cloud dependencies.
- No GPU throughput has been measured yet — all benchmarks above ran CPU-only.

## Core Documentation & Guides
- [Introduction](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/INTRODUCTION.md): Core vision, feature matrix, and architectural philosophy.
- [Architecture Deep Dive](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE_DEEP_DIVE.md): Detailed A.N.T. design pattern, sequence diagrams, and ONNX multi-provider fallback hierarchy.
- [AI Agent Integration Guide](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/AI_AGENT_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md): Native tool schemas, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic RAG patterns.
- [GEO & SEO Implementation Status](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/GEO_AND_SEO_OPTIMIZATION.md): Technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD graph, and generative search citation optimization.
- [Benchmark Report](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS_2026.md): Reproducible in-repo engine bake-off (RapidOCR vs. EasyOCR vs. Tesseract-backed baseline) with sources for every number.
- [API Reference](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/API_REFERENCE.md): Full Python SDK, CLI arguments, and FastAPI REST endpoint schemas.
- [Performance Tuning](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE_TUNING.md): ONNX batch sizing, SIMD pre-processing, and sliding-window memory tuning.
- [Security Hardening](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_HARDENING.md): Sandboxed file access, path traversal prevention, and 8-class forensic PII redaction.
- [Deployment Guide](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md): Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and production multi-worker swarm setup.
- [Troubleshooting & Recovery](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Common failure modes, self-healing recipes, and recovery mechanisms.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints & Manifests
- [Unified Specification (llms-full.txt)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/llms-full.txt): Complete single-prompt documentation file for full context ingestion.
- [AI Plugin Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): OpenAI and ChatGPT action manifest.
- [Model Context Protocol Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/mcp.json): Native stdio/SSE MCP tool definitions for AI agents.
- [XML Sitemap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/sitemap.xml): Search engine and agent crawler index.
- [Robots Directives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/robots.txt): AI crawler and search bot crawling directives.
- [Live Demo](https://ocr-book.streamlit.app/): Interactive Streamlit UI — try the pipeline without installing anything.
- Note: `openapi.json` is generated by the FastAPI server (`blast_ocr/api/app.py`) at runtime; it exists only once that server is deployed and reachable, not as a static file in this repo.
